outcomes.outcome: the script is installed with the owner and the listed connections
with both answers matching, every listed connection present gets the password, and an unlisted one is left alone
openvpn_nm_connection's own profiles (agent-owned password) get the password
cancelling at either dialog changes nothing
blank or mismatched answers are refused with a message and asked again, then a match sets the password
running the script again changes the password of a listed connection (the next password change)
